faqs.question: What are good Halloween costumes for 4 friends?
faqs.answer: Pick a set with exactly four distinct roles, such as the Bremen Town Musicians (donkey, hound, cat, cock), the Four Horsemen of Revelation 6, the four medieval humours or four of Poe's horrors. Each role should carry its own prop, pose and line so nobody ends up as background.

faqs.question: How do we decide who plays which role in a four-person costume?
faqs.answer: Make sure every role has a prop, a pose and a sound or line first, then draw roles from a hat and allow one swap each. For the humours, let the other three vote on which temperament fits each friend.

faqs.question: How much does a homemade four-person Halloween costume cost per person?
faqs.answer: Our estimates for homemade versions, as of October 2026, run from about $5–12 per person for closet-based sets like the four humours to $15–25 for the Four Horsemen, where hobby horses are most of the cost. These are estimates, not retailer prices.

faqs.question: Which four-person costume is easiest to make the night before?
faqs.answer: The four humours and the four winds. Both lean on clothes you already own in one colour each, plus a printed sash or a simple prop, and take about 30 minutes to 2 hours.

faqs.question: How should four friends pose for a group Halloween photo?
faqs.answer: Try four layouts before the party: a line abreast, a V with the middle two forward, a 2×2 grid with two seated, and a staircase with each friend a step higher. Keep faces visible, since a 2026 study found facially expressive people were rated warmer in small groups.

faqs.question: Is the Pestilence rider really one of the Four Horsemen?
faqs.answer: Not by name. In the King James text of Revelation 6, only the fourth rider, on the pale horse, is named, and he is Death. The first rider has a bow and a crown and goes out conquering; Pestilence is a later popular label.

faqs.question: Are the Bremen Town Musicians a Halloween story?
faqs.answer: It is a Grimm fairy tale rather than a Halloween tale, but it has a spooky turn. In the 1884 Hunt translation, the robbers flee because they think a ghost has burst in when the four animals make their music at the window.

faqs.question: What if one of our four friends drops out at the last minute?
faqs.answer: Choose a set whose roles stand alone, such as the 19th-century novel monsters or Poe's four, which still make sense as three. The Four Horsemen and the arcade maze ghosts look unfinished without the fourth.

faqs.question: Can SubhSandesh make one Halloween page for all four of us?
faqs.answer: No. Both SubhSandesh Halloween templates are made for one recipient, with partner, bestie, family and kids modes, and cannot invite a group. Use one afterwards for a single friend, such as the one who took the hardest role.

faqs.question: When is Halloween in 2026 and 2027?
faqs.answer: Halloween is on 31 October every year: Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027. Settle your four roles at least a week ahead so the props have time to dry.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Costumes for 4 Friends: 8 Quartets Where Nobody Gets the Boring Part

The best Halloween costumes for 4 friends are sets with exactly four distinct parts, such as the Bremen Town Musicians, the Four Horsemen or the four medieval humours, where each person gets a prop, a pose and a moment of their own. Start early, because people rarely do: in SubhSandesh's Raksha Bandhan 2026 data, our nearest festival analogue (n = 89), 49.4% of pages were built on the day itself.

Because 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone, every set here is judged on how it reads in one phone-sized photo. Below: 8 sets, each with roles, a cost estimate per head and a photo plan.

## Why is four the easiest group size for a costume?

Researchers treat four as the upper limit for one shared conversation. A 2026 study in the *Journal of Nonverbal Behavior* [capped its groups at four people](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13253780) because that size "provides the optimal environment for individuals to actively partake in a single conversation". Its 254 participants met in 72 groups of three or four.

Four is also a size people naturally move in. In a 2010 PLOS ONE study of about 1,500 pedestrian groups, [groups of two to four were the most frequent and groups of five or more were rare](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC2850937). A quartet can walk, talk and pose as one unit.

## 8 four-person Halloween costumes with a fair role split

Each set has exactly four roles, each with a prop, a pose and a sound or line. Costs are our estimates for homemade versions from US craft and thrift supplies, October 2026, not retailer prices.

### 1. The Bremen Town Musicians

In the Grimms' tale, a donkey, a hound, a cat and a cock stack themselves at a robbers' window and make music. In the [1884 Hunt translation](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/5314) the robbers run off "thinking no otherwise than that a ghost had come in", which makes it a quiet Halloween story.

- **Donkey:** the base of the stack and the loudest bray; suits the tallest friend.
- **Hound:** a collar and a sheet-music scroll; leads the barking.
- **Cat:** whiskers and a fiddle bow; gets the best mew.
- **Cock:** red felt comb and the final crow.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $8–15 each; a staircase, not a real tower, with the donkey kneeling in front and each friend behind one step higher.

### 2. The Four Horsemen

The riders come from Revelation 6, each with a different horse and object. One correction: the King James text names only the fourth rider, "Death". The first rider is not called "Pestilence"; he carries a bow and a crown and goes out "conquering" ([Revelation 6:2–8](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/10)).

- **White horse:** paper crown and a toy bow.
- **Red horse:** a large foam sword.
- **Black horse:** a pair of kitchen scales held high.
- **Pale horse:** ashen make-up and a hood; the only rider the text names.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $15–25 each, mostly hobby horses; four abreast, mid-gallop towards the camera.

### 3. The four humours

Old medicine sorted temperament into blood, yellow bile, black bile and phlegm. Each friend plays the humour the other three vote for, which is half the fun.

- **Sanguine:** red top and a permanent grin.
- **Choleric:** yellow top, arms folded, mock temper.
- **Melancholic:** all black, a poetry book and a sigh.
- **Phlegmatic:** pale blanket cape and a mug; refuses to be rushed.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $5–12 each, mostly your own clothes plus a name sash; a 2×2 grid, two seated and two standing.

### 4. Edgar Allan Poe's four horrors

Four public-domain Poe works give four roles: "The Masque of the Red Death" (1842), "The Tell-Tale Heart" (1843), "The Black Cat" (1843) and "The Raven" (1845).

- **The Raven:** black feathers and one word, "Nevermore".
- **The Black Cat:** ears, a tail and one white patch on the chest.
- **The Tell-Tale Heart:** a red felt heart that the wearer taps to a beat.
- **The Red Death:** a red mask and a cloak; comes last in every room.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $10–20 each; the Red Death at the back, centre, the others curved in front.

### 5. Four 19th-century novel monsters

Four monsters from novels published between 1818 and 1897, each carrying a cardboard "first edition" with the book's year.

- **The creature (1818):** bolts of grey card and heavy boots.
- **Dorian Gray (1890):** a smart suit and an empty picture frame.
- **The Invisible Man (1897):** bandages and dark glasses; unwrap the face for photos.
- **Dracula (1897):** cape, high collar, and a polite bow.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $10–25 each; Dorian holds the frame around the creature's face while the other two lean in.

### 6. The arcade maze ghosts

The four ghosts from the 1980 arcade game Pac-Man come in red, pink, cyan and orange. Each friend wears a coloured sheet-ghost with a zigzag hem.

- **Red, pink, cyan, orange:** one colour each, decided by a draw.
- **The shared gag:** all four sets of eyes look the same way, then switch together when one friend whistles.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $6–12 each; one staggered line, as if turning a maze corner.

### 7. The four winds

Greek myth gave each direction a wind: Boreas the north, Notus the south, Eurus the east and Zephyrus the west. Play them as puffed-cheek faces.

- **Boreas:** icy blue, frost glitter in the beard or brows.
- **Notus:** warm orange, a rain-cloud prop.
- **Eurus:** grey and gold, a paper leaf flurry.
- **Zephyrus:** pale green, a flower crown.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $5–15 each; four corners of a paper compass rose, all blowing towards the middle.

### 8. Hansel, Gretel, the witch and the gingerbread house

This Grimm tale has three people, so the fourth role is the house. Whoever wears it gets the centre spot.

- **Hansel:** a breadcrumb trail of paper crumbs.
- **Gretel:** an apron and an oven mitt.
- **The witch:** a shawl, a cane and very polite menace.
- **The gingerbread house:** a decorated cardboard box with a felt-sweet roof.
- **Cost and photo:** est. $5–10 each, the house $20–30; the children nibble while the witch peeks out from behind.

## Four-person costume sets compared

Here the eight sets are sorted into four effort bands. Costs are homemade estimates, October 2026.

| Set type | Sets | Est. cost per person | Build time each | Faces visible in photos |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fairy-tale casts | Bremen musicians; Hansel and Gretel | $5–30 | 1–3 hours | Yes |
| Literary horror | Poe's four; novel monsters | $10–25 | 2–3 hours | Yes, once the bandages come off |
| Old-world fours | Horsemen; humours; winds | $5–25 | 30 min–2 hours | Yes |
| Arcade ghosts | Maze ghosts | $6–12 | 1 hour | No, unless the eyes are cut out |

Short on time? The humours and the winds come mostly from wardrobes. The ghosts are cheap but hide every face.

## How to split four roles so no one gets the boring part

Give every role a prop, a pose and a sound or line, and rewrite any role that lacks them before anyone draws. The house, the donkey and the pale rider start as "background" parts and become the best ones once they get the centre spot.

Passive roles cost more than they seem to. In a 2024 *Memory & Cognition* study of 60 students in groups of three, [overhearers later recalled less of a conversation than speakers and addressees](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12141120). A costume role with nothing to say or do risks the same.

- Draw roles from a hat, then allow one swap each.
- Pair up for the build: two friends make the props, two do face paint.
- Give the heaviest costume first choice of seat and photo spot.

## Group photo layouts that work for four people

Four faces fit one portrait phone screen, so rehearse these layouts before the party. Keep faces visible: in the 2026 study, more facially expressive people were rated warmer and sat more centrally in their group, while attractiveness did not predict standing.

- **Line abreast:** four in a row facing the camera, the way the 2010 study found friends walk on quiet streets.
- **V or arrow:** the centre two step forward, the shape groups bend into as crowds thicken.
- **2×2 grid:** two seated, two standing.
- **Staircase:** front to back, one step higher each time.

## Sending one of the four a Halloween page

SubhSandesh's two Halloween pages are made for a single recipient, so neither can invite or organise a quartet. Where they fit is afterwards, for the friend who drew the hardest role, like the donkey who knelt through every photo.

The [interactive Halloween card for your donkey friend](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) is about a 5-minute build with room for six photos, and its bestie setting turns the closing question into "Will you be my boo-st friend forever?". The [premium Halloween page with your own voice](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) is about a 10-minute build and holds 12 photos plus a recorded message of up to 60 seconds.

Pick the card if a short thanks will do; pick premium if your friend should hear you say it. 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators set a password before sending the link, and other occasions sit in the [full list of SubhSandesh templates](https://subhsandesh.in/templates).

## When four matching costumes backfire

A quartet breaks if one person drops out at 6 pm. If anyone is unsure, choose the novel monsters or Poe's four, whose roles stand alone, over the Horsemen or the maze ghosts, which look unfinished without the fourth.

Busy streets are another limit: the 2010 study found the V formation reduces the flow of the crowd around it, so walk in pairs between parties. SubhSandesh is limited here too: each page reaches one person, its interface is English only, and it cannot collect RSVPs. Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027.

## Sources

- Balabanova, A. et al. (2026). [Facially Expressive People are More Popular in Newly Formed Groups](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13253780). *Journal of Nonverbal Behavior*, 27 April 2026.
- Moussaïd, M. et al. (2010). [The walking behaviour of pedestrian social groups and its impact on crowd dynamics](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC2850937). *PLOS ONE*, 7 April 2010.
- Brown-Schmidt, S. et al. (2024). [Remembering conversation in group settings](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12141120). *Memory & Cognition*, 5 September 2024.
- Grimm, J. and W. (1884 translation by Margaret Hunt). [Household Tales](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/5314), "Bremen Town-Musicians". Project Gutenberg eBook #5314.
- [The King James Bible](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/10), Revelation 6:2–8. Project Gutenberg eBook #10.

sources.stat: 254 participants (262 recruited) in 72 online groups of three or four; group size was capped at four because it 'provides the optimal environment for individuals to actively partake in a single conversation'; more facially expressive individuals were rated warmer and more cooperative and were more central in the group network, while facial attractiveness did not predict social standing (Balabanova, Kavanagh, Kupfer, Waller, J Nonverbal Behav 50, doi:10.1007/s10919-026-00514-6). Full text read.

Approximately 1,500 pedestrian groups analysed; groups of two to four are the most frequent and five or more rare; at low density members walk side by side at about 90° to the walking direction, and at higher density the line bends into a forward V that aids conversation but reduces crowd flow (Moussaïd et al., PLOS ONE 5(4):e10047). Full text read.

60 participants recruited in groups of three recalled 60 conversations; after a brief delay, overhearers recalled significantly less content than speakers and addressees and sourced it less accurately (Brown-Schmidt, Jaeger, Lord, Benjamin, Memory & Cognition 53, doi:10.3758/s13421-024-01630-8). Full text read.

'Bremen Town-Musicians' (Hunt translation, 1884): donkey, hound, cat and cock stack at the robbers' window; the robbers flee 'thinking no otherwise than that a ghost had come in'. Public domain; full text read.

Revelation 6:2–8 (King James Version): white horse rider with a bow and a crown, 'conquering'; red horse rider with a great sword; black horse rider with a pair of balances; pale horse rider 'his name ... was Death'. Only the fourth rider is named. Public domain; full text read.

Costs are homemade estimates from US craft/thrift supplies as of October 2026, not retailer prices.

auditReport.honestAssessment: The two live competitors (Elite Daily 2017, Refinery29 2019) are undated-feeling pop-culture lists with shopping links and no cost, role split or photo plan; this post is the only one giving public-domain quartets with a per-role prop/pose/line, dated cost estimates, a four-person layout, a sourced Revelation correction and a 2026 group-size study. It still has no Halloween-specific first-party data and a low-authority domain against seven spam-heavy but entrenched results, so any gain will take months and is not predictable.
